business_summary: Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, designs, manufactures, and sells home furnishing products in China. It offers civilian furniture and supporting home products, as well as solutions for house furniture and household products. Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd. 중국에서 홈퍼니싱 제품을 연구, 개발, 디자인, 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 민간 가구와 가정용품 지원은 물론 가정용 가구와 가정용품 솔루션도 제공합니다. Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd. 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
